consequences: The compiler runway must produce an exact protocol-machine program and effective-contract artifact before a generic interpreter can claim conformance.
Current Python protocol handlers remain comparison evidence until independent machine replay passes and the later Assent hard cutover deletes them without fallback.
The Small Shop vertical may publish neutral population and construction plans plus a generic validation receipt, but it cannot add domain or Malleus Code semantics to Core.
constraints: The validated contract fact set is the strict neutral contract IR. A closed typed canonical protocol-machine program owns event vocabulary, payload shapes, preconditions, legal order, transitions, effects, atomicity, typed refusals, declared capabilities, and exact policy references.
Policy and projection programs remain separately identified. Machine semantic identity, executor identity, policy identity, and projection identity are distinct and bound where consumed.

A conforming interpreter contains no profile-specific event, record, field, or refusal literal and no profile-specific branch. It executes only the closed machine artifact through declared generic operations.
Capabilities are closed, typed, and identity-bound. Host-language expressions, unrestricted callbacks, dynamic imports, and arbitrary-code escape hatches cannot carry protocol authority.
The same exact artifact, prestate, input event, and declared side inputs produce the same exact poststate and receipt, or unchanged state and typed refusal, in every conforming implementation.

Lean Review is the first bounded conformance slice. This decision selects no DSL, public API, artifact bytes, runtime implementation, ontology YAML, package, dependency, candidate, selection, or worker ledger.
An LLM may assist ontology or program authoring outside the deterministic kernel. Acceptance, replay, and compiler authority remain model-free and deterministic.
data.selected_option: Protocol authority is exact data executed by a generic interpreter

summary: Make protocol authority exact data executed by a generic interpreter.
why: A protocol is portable only when another conforming implementation can load the same identified contract, machine, policy, and projection artifacts and reproduce the same result. Profile-specific Python branches make Python the authority. This decision puts meaning in closed canonical data, keeps execution generic, and reserves implementation and deletion for independently tested later stages.
